description: Owner only, signed-in session: choose where AI providers process this workspace's call audio and text — "eu" (European Union) or "us" (United States). No call starts until a region is chosen. Choosing it means accepting this statement: "I am the owner of this workspace. I have chosen this processing region myself and confirm it meets the data protection laws, contracts and customer commitments that apply to this workspace and the people it calls. SAGOT processes call audio and text in the region I choose and is not responsible for the consequences of choosing a region that does not meet those obligations." Applies to calls queued after the change.

acceptResponsibility.description: Must be true: the owner accepts processingRegionStatement (see the description).
